tools.name: overview
tools.description: Snapshot of the user's Decknote account: plan and limits, recent boards, what needs attention (overdue and due-today tasks, unread notifications, upcoming reminders), sharing (pending invitations, shared boards, public links, live embeds) and suggested next steps. Useful at the start of a conversati

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Lists the boards the user can access, each with its lists (ids and titles), the user's role on it (OWNER, EDITOR or VIEWER), whether it is archived and whether it is a favorite. These board and list ids identify boards and lists everywhere else in this server.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Creates a new board owned by the user. `template` sets the initial lists and labels, in the user's language: blank (To do / In progress / Done), kanban, content or personal; `lists` replaces the template's list titles. Returns the board with its list ids. The free plan allows 5 owned boards.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Adds a list (column) to a board, at the end or, with first: true, before the other lists. Returns the new list with its id. Needs edit access to the board.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Searches the user's tasks (cards) across boards by free text in title and description, and by board, list, status (open, completed, all or archived) and due date. Answers questions like what is still open, what was noted about something, or what is due soon.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Reads one task in full: title, description, dates, completion, board and list, labels, assignees, checklists with their items, comments with reactions, attachments, links to other tasks, custom field values, whether the user watches it and the user's pending reminders, with the id of each part.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Adds a task (card) to a list, or to a board's first list when only boardId is given. The description becomes the card's page and accepts Markdown (headings, bullet and numbered lists, - [ ] task lists, bold, italic, code, links, fenced code). Optional due date, reminders, repeat (Pro) and a checklis

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Edits a task: title, description, due date, start date, repeat or cover (a color, or one of the task's image attachments). The description accepts Markdown and replaces the card's whole page. null clears a date, the repeat or the cover.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Marks a task as completed (done).

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Marks a completed task as not done again.

tools.name: archive_task
tools.description: Archives a task: it leaves the board but keeps all its data and can be restored from the board's archive. Archiving a dated repeating task creates its next occurrence, as in the app.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Moves a task to another list: on the same board, optionally to a position (index 0 = top), or on another board the user can edit (it lands at the end). Moving to another board drops the old board's labels and the assignees and watchers who can't see the new board, as in the app.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a task as the user. By default nobody is notified. With notify: true it notifies @mentioned board members and the card's watchers by push and email, as commenting in the app does; that needs confirm: true, and without it the result is a preview of who would be notified.

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Adds a reminder for the user on a task: a push notification and an email at a chosen moment. Either `at` (an ISO 8601 instant), or relative to the due date (`daysBefore` + local `time` + IANA `timeZone`), which follows the due date when it moves and repeats with repeating tasks.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: Lists the user's pending reminders, soonest first, optionally on one board, with each task's title and due date.

tools.name: remove_reminder
tools.description: Deletes one of the user's reminders.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the open and completed cards of every board the user can access by text in title and description. Returns card ids, titles (with the board) and links.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Reads one card by id as a document: title, board and list, due date, labels, description, checklists and comments.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Reads one board in full, like opening it in the app: lists with their cards (dates, labels, assignees, checklist progress, custom field values), labels, members and the user's role, custom fields, rules, card templates, the user's saved views, recently archived cards, the public link and pending inv

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: Lists a board's activity history, newest first: who did what, and when. How far back it goes follows the board owner's plan (Free: 40 entries, Pro: 200), as in the app.

tools.name: update_board
tools.description: Changes a board's title, icon (one emoji), cover color or background image (Pro; PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF up to 5 MB, base64-encoded), or removes the background. Needs edit access to the board.

tools.name: set_board_preferences
tools.description: Sets the user's own preferences for a board: favorite (starred) and muted (no notifications from it). Affects only the user.

tools.name: duplicate_board
tools.description: Copies a board the user can see into a new board the user owns: lists, cards (content, dates, checklists, labels) and look. Members, comments and attachments are not copied. Counts toward the free plan's 5 owned boards.

tools.name: archive_board
tools.description: Archives a board the user owns: it leaves everyone's dashboard and keeps all its data until it is restored. Archived boards don't count toward the free plan's 5 owned boards.

tools.name: restore_board
tools.description: Restores an archived board the user owns to everyone's dashboard.

tools.name: delete_board
tools.description: Permanently deletes a board the user owns, with every list, card, comment and attachment on it, also for the people it is shared with. Irreversible. Without confirm: true nothing is deleted and the result is a preview of what would be lost.

tools.name: import_trello_board
tools.description: Creates a board from a Trello JSON export (in Trello: Menu → Print, export and share → Export as JSON): lists, cards with Markdown descriptions, dates, labels, checklists, comments and links. Counts toward the free plan's 5 owned boards.

tools.name: share_board
tools.description: Shares a board the user owns with someone by email, as EDITOR or VIEWER. People whose account has a verified email get access right away; anyone else gets an invitation link by email and joins when they open it (or when they verify that address). Decknote emails them either way, so it needs confirm:

tools.name: update_member
tools.description: Changes a member's role on a board the user owns: EDITOR (can change things) or VIEWER (read only).

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Removes someone from a board the user owns: they lose access, and their assignments, watches and reactions on it are removed (their comments stay). Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: leave_board
tools.description: Removes the user from a board someone else shared with them; only the owner can add them back. The owner can't leave their own board. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: transfer_board
tools.description: Hands a board the user owns to one of its members: they become the owner (their plan then decides the board's Pro features) and the user stays on as an editor. On a project, the user's invoices, estimates and its expenses move to an archived copy in the user's account, the user's recurring invoices

tools.name: set_public_link
tools.description: Turns a board's public read-only link on or off, or issues a new one so the old one stops working. Anyone with the link can view the board without an account. Owner only. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: list_embeds
tools.description: Lists the live embeds of a board the user owns (the board shown inside another app of the user's).

tools.name: create_embed
tools.description: Lets another app of the user's show this board in an iframe (Pro, owner only): a name and up to 5 https origins allowed to frame it, read-only unless canEdit. That app's server then requests a session through the REST API. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: revoke_embed
tools.description: Turns off one of a board's embeds: the app showing it loses access at its next request. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Renames a list, sets its WIP limit (Pro; null clears it) or moves it to another position among the board's lists (index 0 = first). Needs edit access to the board.

tools.name: duplicate_list
tools.description: Copies a list with its open cards (content, dates, labels, checklists) to the end of the same board.

tools.name: sort_list
tools.description: Reorders a list's cards by due date (soonest first, undated last), by title (A to Z) or by creation (newest first).

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Permanently deletes a list and every card in it, archived ones included. Irreversible. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview with the number of cards that would be lost.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Adds a label to a board. Colors: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, sky, pink.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Renames or recolors a label; the change shows on every card that has it.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Deletes a label from a board and removes it from every card that has it. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: create_custom_field
tools.description: Adds a custom field to a board's cards: text, number, select (with up to 20 options), checkbox or date. The free plan allows 3 per board.

tools.name: update_custom_field
tools.description: Renames a custom field or changes a select field's options. Removing an option that cards use clears it from them, which needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: delete_custom_field
tools.description: Deletes a custom field and its value on every card. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: create_saved_view
tools.description: Saves a personal view of a board: how to show it (board, table, calendar or timeline) and a filter (due date, labels, assignees). Only the user sees it. The free plan allows 3 per board.

tools.name: delete_saved_view
tools.description: Deletes one of the user's saved views. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: create_automation
tools.description: Adds a board rule: WHEN a card is added to a list / moved to a list / gets a label, THEN move it, add or remove a label, assign someone, set the due date N days ahead, archive it, or comment. Triggers: card_added, card_moved, label_added (card_added/card_moved need triggerListId, label_added needs t

tools.name: set_automation_enabled
tools.description: Turns a board rule on or off without deleting it.

tools.name: delete_automation
tools.description: Deletes a board rule. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: duplicate_task
tools.description: Copies a task right below the original: title, description, dates, labels, cover, field values and checklists (not comments, assignees or attachments).

tools.name: restore_task
tools.description: Puts an archived task back on its list.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task with its comments, checklists and attachments. Irreversible. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview of what would be lost.

tools.name: set_task_labels
tools.description: Adds and/or removes labels of the task's board on a task. Adding a label runs the board's 'label added' rules, as in the app.

tools.name: set_task_assignees
tools.description: Assigns or unassigns board members on a task. Assigning someone other than the user sends them a push and an email, as in the app, so it needs confirm: true and returns a preview without it; self-assigning and unassigning don't.

tools.name: watch_task
tools.description: Starts or stops watching a task (watchers are notified of new comments on it). Affects only the user.

tools.name: set_task_field
tools.description: Sets a custom field's value on a task, or clears it with null. text: any text; number: a number; select: one of its options; checkbox: true or false; date: YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: link_tasks
tools.description: Relates two tasks on the same board: 'blocks' (from blocks to) or 'relates' (both ways).

tools.name: unlink_tasks
tools.description: Removes a relation between two tasks.

tools.name: bulk_tasks
tools.description: Acts on up to 100 tasks of one board at once, like multi-select in the app: moves them to a list, adds a label, or archives them (repeating ones create their next occurrence).

tools.name: create_task_from_template
tools.description: Adds a task to a list from one of the board's card templates.

tools.name: save_task_as_template
tools.description: Saves a task's description and labels as a reusable card template on its board.

tools.name: delete_card_template
tools.description: Deletes a card template; tasks made from it stay. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: edit_comment
tools.description: Edits a comment's text (the user's own, or any on a board the user owns). It shows as edited.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Deletes a comment (the user's own, or any on a board the user owns). Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: react_to_comment
tools.description: Adds or removes the user's emoji reaction on a comment. Emojis: 👍 ❤️ 🎉 😄 👀 🚀.

tools.name: add_checklist
tools.description: Adds a checklist with its items to a task, in addition to its other checklists.

tools.name: update_checklist
tools.description: Renames a checklist or moves it among the task's checklists (index 0 = top).

tools.name: delete_checklist
tools.description: Deletes a checklist with all its items. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: add_checklist_items
tools.description: Adds items at the end of a checklist.

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.description: Checks or unchecks a checklist item, or changes its text.

tools.name: delete_checklist_item
tools.description: Deletes one checklist item. A checklist keeps at least one item, so its last item only goes away with the whole checklist. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Attaches a link (url) or a file (contentBase64 + filename) to a task. Files follow the board owner's plan: 5 MB each and 100 MB per board on Free, 25 MB and 2 GB on Pro. Photos are optimized, as in the app.

tools.name: rename_attachment
tools.description: Renames an attachment; a file keeps its extension.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Deletes an attachment from a task (and the task's cover, if it was the cover image). Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: list_my_tasks
tools.description: Lists the user's tasks across every board, like the app's My tasks page: open cards assigned to the user plus dated cards on the user's own boards that nobody is assigned to, grouped as overdue, today, next 7 days, later and no date.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Lists the user's notifications (mentions, assignments, comments on watched cards, due-date digests), newest first, with the unread count.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Marks notifications as read: one (notificationId, which also marks the others about the same card, as opening it in the app does), every one about a card (cardId), or all of them (all: true).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Reads the user's account and settings: name, email, language, time zone, notification preferences, plan with its limits and usage, upgrade prices, API tokens and connected apps (names and dates only; secrets are not included).

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Changes the user's settings: display name, language (en, es, fr), time zone (IANA, e.g. America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires; the daily digest goes out in the user's morning) and which notifications they get (mention, assigned, comment, due; email turns emails on or off).

tools.name: revoke_access
tools.description: Revokes one of the user's API tokens (apiTokenId) or disconnects a connected app (appClientId), as listed in the account. Whatever used it stops working at once, including this connection if it is the one in use. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview. New tokens are only created by

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Lists the account's webhooks and Slack channels: kind (slack or json), a shortened address, the board it listens to (null: every board the user owns, plus invoices and estimates), the event types it sends, whether it is on, and how its last delivery went (lastStatus, lastError, lastSentAt; it turns

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Adds a webhook: from then on, each chosen event of the user's boards is sent outside Decknote. kind "slack" posts a line to a Slack channel through a Slack incoming-webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/…); kind "json" POSTs the event as JSON to any https URL (Zapier, Make, n8n, a server), signed in

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Changes one of the account's webhooks: the event types it sends, turns it off or on (enabled), or replaces its signing secret (rotateSecret: the new one comes back once, and the old one stops verifying). Turning it on needs confirm: true, since events leave Decknote again; without it the result is a

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Deletes one of the account's webhooks: nothing more is sent to its address. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Sends a test to one of the account's webhooks now and returns how it went (ok, HTTP status, error): a sample of the first event type it sends, marked "test": true (a Slack channel gets a line saying it is connected). Needs confirm: true, since it sends to an address outside Decknote; without it the

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Exports everything the user can read in Decknote as one JSON document (boards, lists, cards, checklists, comments, attachment metadata), the same export as Settings → Your data. Up to 5 per hour.

tools.name: start_pro_checkout
tools.description: Starts an upgrade to Decknote Pro (14-day free trial, then US$9/month or US$90/year) by creating a Stripe Checkout link where the user pays; this tool charges nothing. Without confirm: true it returns the exact price and changes nothing; with confirm: true, amount has to equal that price. Accounts b

tools.name: open_billing_portal
tools.description: Creates a link to Stripe's billing portal, where the user manages their Pro subscription: payment card, invoices, monthly or yearly billing, cancellation. Changes happen there, made by the user.

tools.name: api_read
tools.description: Reads from Decknote's HTTP API (reference: https://decknote.app/api-docs#mcp-http-api) as the signed-in user, with GET; it doesn't change anything. Covers what no dedicated tool returns, such as the contents of an uploaded text file or a link preview. Reachable: GET /api/v1/me: the user (id, name, e

tools.name: api_create
tools.description: Creates something through Decknote's HTTP API (reference: https://decknote.app/api-docs#mcp-http-api) as the signed-in user, with POST. Reachable: POST /api/v1/boards: a board: { title, template? }; POST /api/v1/cards: a card: { listId | boardId, title, description?, dueDate?, checklist?, reminders?

tools.name: show_board
tools.description: Shows a board as an interactive kanban that updates live while the conversation is open: lists and cards with labels, due dates, checklist progress and assignees, where the user can drag cards between lists, complete them and add new ones. Without boardId it shows the board the user changed most rec

tools.name: get_board_live_url
tools.description: Returns a short-lived address (2 minutes to connect) of a board's live event stream: a Server-Sent Events URL that announces every change to the board and who is viewing it. Used by the board view to update itself.

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: Starts the user's time tracker on a project, optionally on one of its tasks. There is one timer per person: a timer already running is stopped and its time kept first (a timer stopped within 30 seconds is dropped as an accidental click). The hours are the time elapsed when it stops, rounded to the m

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.description: Stops the user's running timer and keeps the elapsed time as a time entry. A timer stopped within 30 seconds is dropped as an accidental click. Says so when no timer was running.

tools.name: get_running_timer
tools.description: Returns the user's running timer, if any: the project, the task, the note, when it started and how long it has run.

tools.name: log_time
tools.description: Adds hours by hand to a project, or to one of its tasks. The entry takes the project's hourly rate (or the client's) and is billable according to the task's setting, else the project's, unless billable is given. Needs the editor role on the project.

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.description: Lists the time entries of a project, newest first, with who logged each, the task, the day, the minutes and whether it is billable. The project owner reads everyone's entries, with their hourly rates in cents; any other member reads only their own, without rates. Also returns the total minutes of ev

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.description: Changes a finished time entry: its duration, day, note, whether it is billable, or the task it is on (null takes it off any task). A person edits their own entries and the project owner edits anyone's. Time already billed to a client, and a timer still running, cannot be edited.

tools.name: delete_time_entry
tools.description: Permanently deletes a time entry, or a running timer. A person deletes their own entries and the project owner deletes anyone's; time already billed to a client cannot be deleted. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview of what would be lost.

tools.name: set_task_estimate
tools.description: Sets how long a task is expected to take, or clears it with null. Written with a unit: 4h, 1h30, 90m, 1.5h (a bare number is minutes); up to 10,000 hours. Needs the editor role on the project.

tools.name: set_task_billable
tools.description: Sets whether time logged on a task is billable to the client (true or false), or makes it follow the project's default (null). Applies to time logged from then on; entries already logged keep their setting. Needs the editor role on the project.

tools.name: get_task_time
tools.description: Reads the time of one task: its estimate, the time tracked so far, how close that is to the estimate (ok, warning from 80%, over), whether its time is billable, and its time entries. The project owner reads everyone's entries; any other member only their own.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: Lists the user's clients (the companies or people projects are done for) with their contact details, currency, default hourly rate in cents and how many projects use each. The free plan includes 2 active clients.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Adds a client. Projects are linked to a client in their settings; the client's currency and default hourly rate apply to their time. The free plan includes 2 active clients; Pro has no limit.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Changes a client's name, contact details, currency, default hourly rate or notes; null clears an optional field. A new rate applies to time logged from then on: entries already logged keep the rate they were logged with.

tools.name: archive_client
tools.description: Archives a client: it leaves the active list and stops counting toward the plan's client limit. Its projects keep the link and all the time stays. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: restore_client
tools.description: Brings an archived client back to the active list. The free plan's limit of 2 active clients applies.

tools.name: get_project_settings
tools.description: Reads a board's project settings: client, status (active, on hold, completed, cancelled), budget (none, hours or money), default hourly rate in cents, whether time is billable by default, and start and due dates. A board without settings is not a project yet. Only the project owner reads the rate an

tools.name: update_project_settings
tools.description: Turns a board into a project or changes its settings: client (one of the user's own), status, budget type with its hours or amount, default hourly rate, billable by default, start and due dates. null clears a value. A new rate applies to time logged from then on. Only the board's owner can do this.

tools.name: get_project_summary
tools.description: Summarizes a project: time tracked, billable time, the billable amount in cents, how much of the budget is used (ok, warning from 80%, over) and the hours of each person. The project owner reads all of it; any other member reads the project's totals and their own hours, without money.

tools.name: get_week_timesheet
tools.description: Returns the user's own timesheet for one week, Monday to Sunday: a row per project and task with the minutes of each day, the totals per day and the week's total.

tools.name: get_time_report
tools.description: Adds up the time logged in a date range, grouped by project, client, person, task or day: minutes, billable minutes and the billable amount in cents (hours times the rate each entry was logged with; clients in different currencies add up as plain numbers). The user's own projects count everyone's ti

tools.name: export_time_report
tools.description: Exports the detail lines of a date range as CSV text (date, project, client, task, person, hours, billable, rate per hour), with the same filters and visibility as the time report. Cells that start with = + - or @ are escaped so a spreadsheet does not run them. A Pro feature; large exports are cut a

tools.name: get_billing_profile
tools.description: Reads the user's billing details that are copied onto every new invoice and estimate: business name, address, tax id, email, phone, currency, the invoice and estimate prefixes and next numbers, the default tax and its name, payment terms in days, payment instructions and default notes. Returns null

tools.name: update_billing_profile
tools.description: Sets or changes the user's billing details: business name (required the first time), address, tax id, email, phone, currency, prefixes and next numbers of invoices and estimates, default tax (percentage and name), payment terms in days, payment instructions and default notes; null clears an optional

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.description: Lists the expenses logged on a project (costs to bill back or to track), newest first, with the person, day, category, description, vendor, amount in cents, whether it is billable and whether it was already invoiced. The project owner reads everyone's, with the markup; any other member only their ow

tools.name: create_expense
tools.description: Logs an expense on a project: what was spent, the amount, the day, a category (travel, software, hardware, services, meals, other), the vendor, whether it can be billed to the client, and optionally a task. It records a cost; nothing is paid. Only the project owner can set a markup (a percentage add

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Changes an expense that is not yet on an invoice: description, amount, day, category, vendor, billable, markup (project owner only) or its task (null removes it). The person who logged it and the project owner can change it.

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.description: Permanently deletes an expense that is not yet on an invoice. The person who logged it and the project owner can delete it. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview of what would be lost.

tools.name: add_expense_receipt
tools.description: Attaches a receipt to an expense: a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, optimized like task photos) or a PDF, sent base64-encoded with its filename. The person who logged the expense and the project owner can add one, also to an expense already on an invoice. At most 10 per expense; each file up to the pr

tools.name: delete_expense_receipt
tools.description: Deletes a receipt of an expense for good. The person who logged the expense and the project owner can delete it. Needs confirm: true; without it the result is a preview.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists the user's invoices and estimates, newest first, 25 per page (up to 100): number, kind, status (draft, sent, paid, overdue, void, accepted, declined), client, project, dates, and total, paid and balance in cents. Also returns, per currency, what the matching invoices add up to, what was paid a

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Reads one invoice or estimate in full: status, dates, the sender and the client copied onto it, every line, tax, discount, totals, payments, balance, the public link (null if none), when it was sent, viewed and paid, the estimate it came from or became, the work attached, and which changes are open

tools.name: get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Returns one invoice or estimate as a PDF file, base64-encoded (contentBase64), with its file name and size: the A4 sheet its client gets by mail and from the link, in English or Spanish (default: the account's language). A draft or a voided document is printed saying what it is. The PDF holds what i

tools.name: get_receivables_aging
tools.description: Shows what clients still owe on sent invoices, by how late it is: not yet due, 1-30 days, 31-60 and 61 or more days past due, per currency and per client (the biggest debt first), in cents.

tools.name: export_invoices_csv
tools.description: Exports the matching invoices and estimates as CSV text for an accountant: number, type, status, dates, client, currency, subtotal, discount, tax, total, paid and balance. Same filters as the list. Cells that start with = + - or @ are escaped so a spreadsheet does not run them. A Pro feature; large

tools.name: get_billing_report
tools.description: A studio's numbers for a date range (default: the last 12 months): invoiced and collected by month, by client and what each client owes, expenses by project and category, and the profitability of each project (revenue, expenses, profit and revenue per hour).
